packet: H5b one physical return path and dated source capacity
scope: A positive stock_return references one stock_out, retains its exact recipient as return_party, and credits one same-entity/resource/unit stock_account destination.

Each stock_out owns one distinct dated z_returns capacity root. Its z_return_grant node contributes the original stock_out quantity at source effective_at; each linked stock_return subtracts its quantity at return effective_at.

A return at the source timestamp is accepted. The stock_out source grant is the first same-time key and stock_return children follow it for these table names; sibling returns with opposite record-ID ordering are also covered.
Stock movement roots and dated return-capacity roots are independently reconstructed from authoritative stock_out, stock_return, stock_in, and stock_transfer rows.

probe.output: H5b physical return, dated self-seeded capacity, lifecycle rollback, and source-row oracle passed
checks: The self-seeded stock_out grant creates a dated pool of exactly the source quantity; the independent oracle matches its sum and complete-timestamp minimum.
A return before its source rejects with complete snapshot equality; return effective_at equal to source effective_at succeeds.
Same-time sibling returns sort by distinct record IDs and update the shared capacity and destination stock roots; a second compatible destination is exercised.
A competing over-return and zero-quantity return reject atomically; positive quantity edits refresh the dated capacity and stock roots.
Wrong economic entity, resource, unit, and return party reject without changing any source, return, capacity root, or stock root.
Reducing or moving the stock_out source so active returns become invalid rejects atomically; deleting a source with linked returns and deleting used stock accounts are protected.
Return destination/date edit succeeds; return delete prunes both capacity and destination tree slots; re-addition retains the same record ID.
The independent stock oracle includes historical opening stock, stock-out, and return facts; the capacity oracle groups source grant and all linked returns by effective timestamp.

observed_same_timestamp_key_order.interpretation: The table-name ordering fixes stock_out before stock_return in this domain fixture. The adverse reversed-key case is covered by the generic boundary-tree probe; this H5b fixture proves equal-time acceptance and stable same-time returns without claiming a reversed source/return key order.

passed after final oracle and zero-quantity assertion

limits: This packet establishes one physical return and its dated source-quantity cap only. It does not imply a cash refund or claim correction; H5c is a separate active packet.

The H5a stock-account complete-timestamp minimum remains account-level capacity. This H5b source cap is per stock_out and does not establish source-specific gross input availability or prevent a recipe from funding its own inputs.

The disposable probe observed stock_out sorting before stock_return at a common timestamp because of table-name ordering. Reversed-key algebra is covered by probe:boundary-tree, but the H5b table pair itself does not reverse that ordering.
No production migration or production lifecycle claim is made.
